Before and after the ''Reviewing the TV Series -- Right, Wrong, and What?'' panel at JordanCon 2026 ({{Date|2026 Apr 18}}), [[Sarah Nakamura]] had an informal conversation with several fans. Much of the content should not be publicized, as Sarah expressly indicated she was avoiding making public statements on those subjects. However a few points were clearly not sensitive or secret, and will be reproduced here as accurately as possible. This is from memory with cursory notes; no recording or detailed notes were made.

Some of these statements were not from the conversations themselves, but publicly stated by Sarah during the panel itself (she was not on the panel, but was sitting near the front in the audience).

== Statements ==

* The Amazon TV show adaptation made $460M in profit.{{ref|The ability for Sarah (or Amazon or anyone) to actually know this is somewhat suspect. Amazon Prime Video revenue is largely not directly attributable to specific productions and must be allocated to particular properties by some algorithm of Amazon's devising (such as percentage of overall watch time or view counts). However, advertising revenue can be directly attributed to specific videos.}} Sarah was unambiguous that this is profit, not revenue.
* Billy Zane, the actor in ''{{TVlink|Winter Dragon}}'', made more money from the Amazon TV show adaptation than did showrunner Rafe Judkins.
* The former employees who spread news of closures and layoffs related to the production of the open-world RPG developed by [[iwot]] studios were not actually employees. They were contractors and the "layoffs" were simply said contractors not being picked up.{{ref|This seems to contradict public statements by iwot studios publishing announcements welcoming some of the individuals, complete with job titles.}} According to Sarah, nothing has closed down.
* ''[[Heroes and Forsaken]]'' has been "shut down."
* [[Loial]]'s fall in the [[Ways]] was intended to be ambiguous with respect to his death or survival.
* Season 4 would have included [[Dumai's Wells]].
* There was no intention to include any romance between [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Min Farshaw]] in the show. The intention was to have [[Elayne]] have concurrent relationships with [[Aviendha]] and Rand.

{{notes}}
